answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents stake tokens to certify topological cut verifications across interaction graphs. If game-theoretic multi-agent auditing detects fraudulent cuts, stake slashing triggers automatically, imposing superlinear attacker cost scaling with graph partition volume.
